note: Mario Party 3 (N64) matched functions, compiled with mainline GCC 2.7.2 at -O1 (the project's own tools/gcc_2.7.2). Project headers preprocess under host cpp, so funcC uses common.h types + per-function extern decls for file-local globals; include_asm.h's top-level `asm(".include ...")` (the INCLUDE_ASM machinery) is stripped at preprocess so the vendored object is self-contained.

functions.prependC:
extern s16 D_800D418E_D4D8E;
extern u8 D_800D2008_D2C08;

functions.note: Two adjacent sub-word fields of opposite signedness — `s16 group` (a `!= -1` sentinel) and `u16 group_idx` (an array subscript). asmlift reads both at the declared signedness (`lh` for the sentinel, `lhu` for the subscript), and the one instruction of residual is the sentinel’s WRITE-BACK: spelled through a `u16` cast it materializes as `li v0,0xffff` where the source’s `obj->group = -1` on the s16 field gives `li v0,-1`.

Three list stores whose value is a single load (`a->b = a->c`). asmlift recovers all three bindings correctly; the three-instruction residual is confined to the last arm, where materializing the stored value into a local (`v1 = a0[4]; ((s32 *)a0[3])[2] = v1;`) emits the value’s load before the base’s, and gcc 2.7.2 then allocates the two registers the other way round than it does for the source’s direct `relative->oldest_child = parent_oldest_child`.
